risk_note: RV2 by the PR (rule tests under test/**; infra/release-scan/** is RV2). Codex-first implementation (ops/approvals.yaml id 23; tools/guard/codex-impl-tasks.json): rule tests by a Claude subagent (spec_commit), container red run on the spec_commit tree, implementation by Codex through codex-run.sh impl --phase impl (3 attempts), then one Opus handover (规划/11 §2.5). Refs BR-ID-09; the brief with its one-hop text passes 24 KB, so the orchestrator wrote it with brief.ts minus the one-hop text plus a pointer to the full BR text. The scanner only tightens: no change to gitleaks or the repository secret scanning; fake secrets in tests are built at run time; Node built-ins only. Written by hand. Exception round (decision 27): an Opus minimal fix of two false blocks on iOS builds after round 4; both families reviewed once more.

reviews.note: fresh read-only Codex sessions, not the implementing one: rounds 1-3 fail, fixed by Codex attempts 2-3 and the Opus handover; rounds 4 and 5 originally fail with 2 S1 each, all in one family (field association across files and non-APK formats: .aab resources.pb; AXML meta-data value / resource references not joined to resources.arsc).
